title_en: Bob Dylan comes knockin' on pope's door as Leo welcomes legend to Vatican
title_zh: 鲍勃·迪伦敲开教皇的门，里奥欢迎传奇来到梵蒂冈

paragraphs.en:
Pope Leo XIV, left, and the singer and Nobel prize winner Bob Dylan, right, pose for a photo during a meeting in the Vatican on Wednesday, Nov. 4, 2026.
 
 
 Vatican Media/LaPresse/via AP
 
 
 hide caption
paragraphs.zh: 教皇利奥十四世（左）和歌手、诺贝尔奖得主鲍勃·迪伦（右）在梵蒂冈会面时合影。摄于2026年11月4日星期三。梵蒂冈媒体/LaPresse/通过美联社隐藏标题

paragraphs.en: VATICAN CITY — Bob Dylan came knockin' on Pope Leo XIV' s door Wednesday, as the American singer-songwriter and poet visited with the American pope at the Vatican during a break between concert dates in Italy.
paragraphs.zh: 梵蒂冈城——周三，鲍勃·迪伦敲开了教皇利奥十四的门，这位美国歌手、词曲作者兼诗人在意大利音乐会的间隙拜访了梵蒂冈。

paragraphs.en: Leo was warning against the race to rearm and the recourse to nuclear weapons and quoted the lyric, addressed to a hypothetical atomic bomb: "I hate you cause yer man-made and man-owned, an' man-handled."
paragraphs.zh: 里奥对重新武装的竞赛和诉诸核武器发出了警告，并引用了一首针对假想的原子弹的歌词：“我恨你，因为你是人造的、人为的、人为的。”

paragraphs.en: Two Vatican officials accompanied Dylan: the Rev. Antonio Spadaro, a Vatican culture ministry official who also accompanied Patti Smith to a July audience with Leo; and Andrea Monda, the editor of the Vatican newspaper, L'Osservatore Romano.
paragraphs.zh: 陪同迪伦的两名梵蒂冈官员是：梵蒂冈文化部官员安东尼奥·斯帕达罗牧师（Rev. Antonio Spadaro），他曾陪同帕蒂·史密斯（Patti Smith） 7月与利奥会面；以及梵蒂冈报纸《罗马观察报》（L’osservatore Romano）的编辑安德里亚·蒙达（Andrea Monda）。

paragraphs.en:
Pope Leo XIV, right, and the singer and Nobel prize winner Bob Dylan, left, talk during a meeting in the Vatican on Wednesday, Nov. 4, 2026.
 
 
 Vatican Media/LaPresse/via AP
 
 
 hide caption
paragraphs.zh: 教皇利奥十四世（右）和歌手、诺贝尔奖得主鲍勃·迪伦（左）在梵蒂冈的一次会议上交谈。摄于2026年11月4日星期三。梵蒂冈媒体/LaPresse/通过美联社隐藏标题

paragraphs.en: Spadaro said Dylan had wanted to speak with Leo, and the two met in private for a few minutes. In an essay in L'Osservatore Romano, he recalled that the former Robert Prevost, who was born in Chicago in 1955, grew up familiar with Dylan's music.
paragraphs.zh: Spadaro说Dylan想和Leo谈谈，两人私下会面了几分钟。在《罗马观察报》（ L 'Osservatore Romano ）的一篇文章中，他回忆起1955年出生于芝加哥的前罗伯特·普雷沃斯特（ Robert Prevost ）从小就熟悉迪伦的音乐。

paragraphs.en: He also noted that Dylan was very familiar with St. Augustine of Hippo, the inspiration of Leo's spirituality and Augustinian religious order, penning "I Dreamed I Saw St. Augustine" for the 1967 album John Wesley Harding.
paragraphs.zh: 他还指出，迪伦非常熟悉河马的圣奥古斯丁，这是狮子座灵性和奥古斯丁宗教秩序的灵感来源，他在1967年的专辑《约翰·韦斯利·哈丁》中写道： “我梦见我看见了圣奥古斯丁”。

paragraphs.en:
Pope Leo XIV, right, and the singer and Nobel prize winner Bob Dylan, left, shake hands during a meeting in the Vatican on Wednesday, Nov. 4, 2026.
 
 
 Vatican Media/LaPresse/via AP
 
 
 hide caption
paragraphs.zh: 教皇利奥十四世（右）和歌手兼诺贝尔奖获得者鲍勃·迪伦（左）于2026年11月4日星期三在梵蒂冈举行的会议上握手。梵蒂冈媒体/LaPresse/通过AP隐藏标题

paragraphs.en: Dylan, who won the Nobel Prize for Literature in 2016, wore a black hoodie and a loose tie. Vatican photos of the encounter showed him with the hood over his head.
paragraphs.zh: 2016年获得诺贝尔文学奖的迪伦身穿黑色连帽衫和宽松领带。梵蒂冈的相遇照片显示，他头上戴着头罩。

paragraphs.en: Dylan, who changed his name from Robert Zimmerman, was born to a Jewish family in Minnesota. He famously became a born-again Christian in 1979 and alienated some of his longtime fans with songs like "Gotta Serve Somebody" and "Saved."
paragraphs.zh: 迪伦（ Dylan ）从罗伯特·齐默尔曼（ Robert Zimmerman ）改名，出生于明尼苏达州的一个犹太家庭。他于1979年成为重生的基督徒，并用“Gotta Serve Somebody”和“Saved”等歌曲疏远了他的一些长期粉丝。
